answer: One concrete defense is bonded stake: every agent must lock real collateral before it can act, so spinning up a sybil fleet forces attackers against a rising tide of capital that drowns them. Honest agents stake once and keep earning, while fakes bleed value. Treat reputation as an atlas mapping each bonded identity to its verified history, so a newcomer sitting on a lonely knoll of zero stake carries almost no voting weight until it proves itself over time.
